samples.question: A reference 5-by-5 glyph is drawn inside the magenta-bordered frame at the top.  Four framed squares below each hold another 5-by-5 glyph, and each square carries a coloured tag just above it: one crimson, one teal, one amber, one violet.  Exactly one of the four tagged glyphs equals the reference glyph after rotating the reference a quarter turn clockwise.  Which colour tag belongs to that matching glyph?  Answer with exactly one of: crimson, teal, amber, violet.
